items.title: 莫桑比克｜Eni启动天然气电站EPC项目意向征集
items.title_en: Mozambique | Eni gas power plant EPC expression of interest
items.summary: Eni Rovuma Basin B.V.征集天然气发电工程设计、采购和施工承包商意向，报道截止2026年10月31日，尚非正式授标。
items.summary_en: Eni Rovuma Basin B.V. has invited expressions of interest for a gas power plant EPC package, with a reported 31 October 2026 deadline; no contract award is implied.
items.why_it_matters: 项目如进入正式采购，将涉及发电与工业基础设施供应链。
items.why_it_matters_en: An eventual EPC procurement could support equipment and industrial infrastructure suppliers.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注燃气轮机、发电设备、钢结构、管道、电气及EPC合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track turbines, generation equipment, steel, piping, electricals and EPC partnerships.

items.title: 赞比亚｜Siloka–Mukuni 400kV输电线路EPC采购
items.summary: ZESCO发布Siloka–Mukuni 400kV输电线路和相关变电站工程采购线索，含两个工程包，报道编号ZESCO/EPC/113/2026与115/2026，截止2026年10月23日；应向采购方核对技术文件。
items.summary_en: ZESCO's reported Siloka–Mukuni 400kV line and substation procurement includes two EPC packages, references ZESCO/EPC/113/2026 and 115/2026, with a stated 23 October deadline; verify the primary documents.
items.why_it_matters: 高压电网工程对设备、土建及本地施工合作有直接需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: High-voltage grid works can create equipment, civil works and local execution demand.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注铁塔、导线、绝缘子、变压器、开关设备和电力施工。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track towers, conductors, insulators, transformers, switchgear and electrical contractors.

items.title: 西班牙｜巴塞罗那港铁路运力扩建第二标段
items.title_en: Spain | Barcelona Port railway capacity expansion Lot 2
items.summary: 巴塞罗那港务局公开招标铁路运力扩建工程第二标段，估算金额约582万欧元，欧盟公告编号718242-2026，报道截标日2026年11月20日。
items.summary_en: Port of Barcelona's railway capacity expansion Lot 2 is reported as a €5.82m tender, EU notice 718242-2026, with a 20 November 2026 deadline.
items.why_it_matters: 港口铁路运输基础设施投资将带动专业工程材料与施工需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: Port rail capacity works may generate specialist infrastructure and material demand.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注轨道、道岔、土建、铁路材料和当地合作商。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track trackwork, turnouts, civil works, rail supplies and local contractors.

items.title: 卡塔尔｜Education City雨水排放管网一期设计施工招标
items.title_en: Qatar | Education City stormwater drainage Phase 1 design-build tender
items.summary: Ashghal公布Education City一期雨水排放及防洪排涝管网设计施工采购，资料所列招标编号PWA/GTC/17/2026，截止2026年11月17日。
items.summary_en: Ashghal lists a Phase 1 design-build stormwater drainage procurement around Education City, reported ref PWA/GTC/17/2026 and deadline 17 November 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 排水设施建设涉及大口径管道、泵站和土建需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: Stormwater infrastructure entails large pipes, pumping systems and civil works.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注大口径排水管、泵站、混凝土预制件及施工机械。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track drainage pipes, pumps, precast concrete and equipment.

items.title: 阿曼｜Al Buraimi内部道路设计施工第4包
items.title_en: Oman | Al Buraimi internal roads design-build package 4
items.summary: Al Buraimi省内部道路设计与施工第4包采购，资料所列编号44/2026/BGO/HQ-44，截止2026年11月19日，境外企业需核实资质和投标资格。
items.summary_en: Al Buraimi's internal road design-build package 4 is reported under ref 44/2026/BGO/HQ-44 with a 19 November deadline; overseas bidders should verify eligibility.
items.why_it_matters: 当地道路工程可为专业设备及材料商提供配套入口。
items.why_it_matters_en: Local roads contracts offer a route for qualified materials and machinery suppliers.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注沥青、道路材料、排水、机械和本地承包配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track bitumen, paving, drainage, machinery and local contractors.

items.title: 摩洛哥｜Rissani医院22kV电力接入工程招标
items.title_en: Morocco | Rissani hospital 22kV power connection works tender
items.summary: 摩洛哥Rissani地方医院22kV架空与地下电力接入工程发布采购，估算约170万迪拉姆，编号12/2026，报道截止2026年11月9日。
items.summary_en: Reported public procurement for overhead and underground 22kV electrical connection works at Rissani local hospital, estimated MAD1.70m, tender ref 12/2026, due 9 November.
items.why_it_matters: 中压电力接入涉及较明确的设备供应和安装需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: Medium-voltage grid connections have defined equipment and installation needs.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注中压电缆、配电柜、开关设备及安装合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track MV cables, switchgear, distribution equipment and installers.

items.title: 坦桑尼亚｜Kakono水电站38.6公里220kV输电线路工程
items.title_en: Tanzania | Kakono hydropower 38.6km 220kV transmission line tender
items.summary: Kakono水电站至Kyaka变电站38.6公里双回路220kV线路工程采购，涉及设计、供货、安装、测试与调试，报道截止2026年11月20日。
items.summary_en: A reported tender covers a 38.6km double-circuit 220kV line from Kakono hydropower to Kyaka substation, with design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning; stated deadline 20 November.
items.why_it_matters: 水电配套输电项目有明确机电材料和施工配套需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: Hydropower grid connection works may require electrical materials and construction.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注铁塔、导线、绝缘子、基础施工及电气安装。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track towers, conductors, insulators, foundations and installations.

items.title: 西班牙｜Puerto del Rosario污水处理厂扩建工程
items.title_en: Spain | Puerto del Rosario wastewater treatment plant expansion
items.summary: 加那利群岛Puerto del Rosario污水处理厂扩建采购，报道估算1420万欧元、截止2026年11月14日，涉及污泥处理及再生水利用工程。
items.summary_en: Reported €14.20m procurement to expand the Puerto del Rosario wastewater treatment plant in the Canary Islands, including sludge treatment and reclaimed water works, with a 14 November deadline.
items.why_it_matters: 污水扩建及再生水设施带来水处理设备及机电工程机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: Expansion and water reuse create procurement opportunities for specialist wastewater suppliers.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注泵阀、污泥脱水、膜系统、自动控制与工程分包。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track pumps, valves, sludge dewatering, membranes, automation and subcontractors.
